summary: Flashbulb Games' block-based vehicle construction sandbox, combining open-world exploration, racing, sandbox challenges, and player-built cars, aircraft, hovercrafts, and other machines.

entries.title: Trailmakers
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with owned DLC

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows with desired DLC/mod content.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings with mods

primary.why: Trailmakers released fully for Windows and Xbox One in 2019 after Early Access, then for PlayStation 4 in 2020. Windows is the most flexible and highest-fidelity route because of PC modding support and the full sandbox/racing feature set.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings with owned DLC and desired workshop/mod content; use Xbox One or PS4 only as console alternatives.

all_releases.fidelity: PC release with modding support, sandbox, adventure, and racing modes.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity and most flexible creation route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows has the best fidelity and most flexible creation/modding route; no console-exclusive content requires a secondary route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or complete edition; DLC maps/expansions should be installed if owned.
